summary: Entities indexes Bunraku's canonical content kinds: CanonicalEntity Kind Body wrappers where body is the superset for one kind. The kinds are a closed set: exactly the src/entities folders holding a kind.ts descriptor, which bun run kinds collects into src/generated/kinds.ts for identity and src/generated/kind-schemas.ts for decoders and storage parts, and every list of kinds in the app (storage folders, the parse boundary, adapter contracts, decks, search, receipts, Kit and New actions) reads those seams; adding one is extending/new-kind. Which kinds have format adapters is the generated format matrix. Every kind stores at studio/<kind>/<id>.json via resolveStudioPath. Generated field tables explains each page's verbatim tables from docs-fields.ts. Reference pages link character, lorebook, pack, persona, preset, Script Sheet, regex, quick-reply set, tool, dice, formula, tracker, prompt format and drawing. Cross-cutting ties the sprite pack hub shape, the RegexScript twin, knowledgeRefs and behaviorRefs, and persona as character's opposite-voice counterpart.

sections.title: Generated field tables
sections.summary: Each entity page embeds its field table verbatim from docs/generated/fields.<kind>.md. That file is generated from live schema JSDoc by scripts/docs-fields.ts via bun run scripts/docs-fields.ts and verified with --check. Do not hand-edit a table cell on an entity page; improve the doc comment in src/entities/<kind>/schema.ts and regenerate so the published table stays the schema truth.

sections.title: Reference pages
sections.summary: Reference pages: index table of the entity field references. Character covers identity, persona and voice, prompts and injections, greetings and examples, media, presentation, settings and behavior, attribution and discovery. Lorebook covers the world info entry set, triggers, position and depth, and per-entry and per-book settings. Pack is a reusable expression sprite pack attachable to several characters. Persona is the user identity counterpart with name, content, sections and chat injection. Preset is a chat-completion prompt-manager preset with ordered blocks, samplers and behavior. Regex is a named ordered find-and-replace rule set, the card twin and standalone files. Quick-reply set is a page of buttons that send prepared text, linked from presets. Tool, dice and formula are small pieces a model may call, roll or run, and Tracker is state a scene keeps: named typed fields as a record or a list, shown to the model every turn and updated by one tool. Prompt format holds SillyTavern instruct and context templates kept whole, read by nothing yet. Drawing is a sealed HTML page shown in HTML View rather than a Library deck.

sections.title: Cross-cutting
sections.summary: Shared shapes span kinds. SpritePackValue and SpritePackItem in core media pack.ts are the hub for Character media.assets role emotion and Pack pack groups. RegexScript makes Character behavior.regexScripts the card-embedded twin of the standalone Regex set. knowledgeRefs and behaviorRefs let Character link standalone Lorebook or Regex entities by canonical id. Persona is Character opposite-voice counterpart sharing prompt-injection machinery as first person user versus third person char.
